description: Parent company and corporate ownership lookup: for any company or subsidiary, returns the parent company with its location, website, description, and a reference URL (for example Instagram to Meta Platforms). For corporate hierarchy research, account rollups, KYB, supplier risk, and sales territory planning. Cost: $0.25 USDC via x402.

language.description: Optional. Two-letter code for results in that language (default English): fr, de, it, es, ja, pt, zh, ar, nl, el, tr, ko, sv, vi, th, id. Same price in every language.

lookup.description: Company name or domain to find parent company for
